qualification: Independent mode/stage bars and complete row fills qualify groups. Boundary paint and expected separator states are checked afterward. Fixture stages change emitted CSS classes; separator presence is not a qualification condition.
limits: This verifies the recorded default Paper and forwarded Box scenarios on this simulator snapshot.
Known peer identity comes from immutable candidate classes. Unknown peers retain only a matching surface/subject/parent/predecessor-bound JS observation.
Replacing an unknown custom peer or changing its CSS on the same host is not native first-paint parity.
Source opacity is intentionally overridden to expose display suppression.
Recorded qualified groups do not establish every display frame, GPU deadlines, conditional text timing, animation-start timing, Android runtime or release performance.
